facts.fact: Benin's government says the TERRA BENIN and PPMEC II projects launched on 6 November 2026 will develop and improve the e-Foncier Benin platform; no transactions processed on it are stated.

Benin's government says PPMEC II (2026-2031, 12 communes) continues cadastral data collection and TERRA BENIN (14 communes first) aims to register 1.5 million parcels, both launched on 6 November 2026.

BEN.note: No local government office connection stated.
